chapters.name: Lost land
chapters.label: What if the sea dropped 130 m?

scenes.title: BRITAIN WASN'T AN ISLAND
scenes.say: Watch Britain stop being an island. Drop the sea by 130 metres, and a lost land called Doggerland rises out of the North Sea, joining Britain to Europe.

scenes.title: THIS REALLY HAPPENED
scenes.small:
Average sea level at the peak
of the last ice age
scenes.say: And this isn't fantasy. At the peak of the last ice age, average sea level was about 130 metres lower than today, and people lived on land that is now under the sea.
